about-hero-subtitle: Trusted global leader in power system design, protection, and control
about-content: At PSAI POWER, we are a trusted global leader in power system design, protection, and control. With extensive experience across diverse regions, including North America, Latin America, the Caribbean, and Asia, we have successfully delivered innovative, reliable, and cost-effective power solutions for utilities, mines, and industrial clients.
about-mission-body: We pride ourselves on our customer-centric approach, working closely with clients to develop tailored solutions that meet their specific needs. Our team is dedicated to delivering innovative power measurement and protection instruments that are easy to install and ensure minimal outage durations.
about-vision-body: We go beyond traditional approaches to bring forward-thinking technologies that improve both the performance and reliability of power systems while minimizing disruptions. Our goal is to lead the industry in advanced grid optimization, renewable energy integration, and cutting-edge protection schemes.
about-expertise-body: Our expertise spans a wide range of power system applications, including Distributed Energy Resource (DER) interconnections to the distribution grid with successful integrations up to 150MW. We understand the unique challenges each project presents and approach each one with a deep understanding of the technical and regulatory environments.
contact-hero-subtitle: We're here to help. Reach out to us for any inquiries or to discuss your next project.
contact-status-success: Thank you for your message! We will get back to you soon.
resource-technical-whitepapers-content: Access our library of technical whitepapers covering advanced power system design, protection schemes, grid modernization strategies, and renewable energy integration methodologies. These documents represent our cutting-edge research and practical implementations across North America.
resource-case-studies-content: Explore real-world case studies showcasing our successful power system projects. Learn about our work with utilities, industrial clients, and renewable energy providers. Each case study details the challenges faced, solutions implemented, and results achieved.
resource-integration-guides-content: Comprehensive guides for Distributed Energy Resource (DER) interconnections, renewable energy integration, and grid modernization. These technical documents provide step-by-step instructions, best practices, and regulatory compliance information.
resource-compliance-documents-content: Access regulatory compliance documentation, standards adherence guidelines, and certification materials. Ensure your power systems meet all necessary industry standards and governmental regulations.
resource-technical-briefs-content: Concise technical briefs covering specific power system topics, innovative solutions, and emerging technologies. Perfect for quick reference and staying updated with industry advancements.
resource-best-practices-content: Industry best practices for power system maintenance, optimization, and reliability. These documents compile decades of experience into actionable guidelines for optimal system performance.

careers-hero-subtitle: Help build reliable, modern power systems for utilities, industry, and mines across Canada.
careers-intro: PSAI POWER is a growing power engineering consultancy. You'll work directly on real substations, industrial plants, and renewable projects — with senior engineers who mentor, a safety-first culture, and room to grow with the practice.
careers-eligibility: Applicants must be legally entitled to work in Canada (Canadian citizen, permanent resident, or valid work permit holder). We are unable to sponsor work visas at this time.
careers-apply-note: Send your resume and a short introduction to
careers-eng-summary: We're looking for an intermediate electrical engineer to grow with our power systems consulting practice. You'll work across power systems studies, protection and control, substation design, and commissioning and testing, as well as industrial medium- and low-voltage electrical design, control, and automation — supporting projects from concept through detailed design to site energization for utility, renewable, and mining clients.
careers-eng-r1: Perform power system studies — load flow, short circuit, protection coordination, arc flash, and grounding — using ETAP or similar tools
careers-eng-r2: Develop protection and control designs for MV/HV substations, including relay selection and settings
careers-eng-r3: Prepare design deliverables: single-line diagrams, layouts, schematics, equipment specifications, and cable schedules
careers-eng-r4: Design industrial MV/LV power distribution, motor control, and automation systems (MCCs, VFDs, PLC/SCADA interfaces)
careers-eng-r5: Support factory and site acceptance testing, commissioning, and energization
careers-eng-r6: Coordinate with other disciplines, vendors, contractors, and clients from concept to close-out
careers-eng-q1: Bachelor's degree (4-year) in Electrical Engineering, or CET diploma with equivalent experience
careers-eng-q2: 3–5 years of relevant experience in power systems, substation, or industrial electrical design
careers-eng-q3: Registered EIT with a Canadian engineering association preferred; P.Eng designation is an asset, not required
careers-eng-q4: Working knowledge of applicable codes and standards (CEC, CSA, IEEE)
careers-eng-q5: Clear communication in reports, drawings, and client-facing discussions
careers-eng-a1: Hands-on experience with ETAP, AutoCAD, and relay programming tools
careers-eng-a2: Field exposure to commissioning or testing of MV/HV equipment
careers-tech-title: Electrical Field Technician — Substations, MV/LV Equipment, Pumps & Motors
careers-tech-summary: We're seeking an electrical field technician to support field installation, inspection, testing, commissioning, troubleshooting, and maintenance of electrical equipment in power substations and industrial facilities — working on medium- and low-voltage systems including transformers, switchgear, breakers, protection relays, MCCs, VFDs, motors, and pumps.
careers-tech-r1: Inspect, test, commission, and maintain substations, MV/LV switchgear, transformers, breakers, CTs/PTs, and control panels
careers-tech-r2: Perform point-to-point wiring checks, breaker timing, insulation and contact resistance, ratio and polarity tests, and energization checks
careers-tech-r3: Troubleshoot and maintain motors, pumps, MCCs, VFDs, soft starters, and motor control circuits
careers-tech-r4: Work with multimeters, insulation testers, low-resistance ohmmeters, relay test sets, phase rotation and power quality meters
careers-tech-r5: Read single-lines, schematics, and wiring diagrams; prepare field reports, deficiency lists, and as-built markups
careers-tech-r6: Follow lockout/tagout, arc-flash boundaries, permit-to-work processes, and site electrical safety rules
careers-tech-q1: Electrical Technician or Technologist diploma, or equivalent electrical trade and field experience
careers-tech-q2: 3–7 years of hands-on field experience with industrial electrical systems, substations, motors, or commissioning
careers-tech-q3: Ability to read and interpret electrical drawings and equipment manuals
careers-tech-q4: Strong understanding of lockout/tagout and electrical safety procedures
careers-tech-q5: Valid driver's licence and willingness to travel to field sites
careers-tech-a1: Substation experience from 4.16 kV to 44 kV, 69 kV or higher
careers-tech-a2: Experience with SEL, GE Multilin, Siemens, Schneider Electric, Eaton, or ABB relays and equipment
careers-tech-a3: Omicron, Doble, Megger, or Vanguard test sets; protection scheme testing
careers-tech-a4: Red Seal licence or CET designation; WHMIS, First Aid, Confined Space, or mine-site safety training
pp-intro: PSAI Power Inc. ("PSAI POWER", "we", "us") respects your privacy. This policy explains what personal information we collect through this website, how we use it, and the choices you have. We handle personal information in accordance with the Personal Information Protection and Electronic Documents Act (PIPEDA) and applicable provincial privacy legislation.
pp-collect-form-body: When you submit our contact form, we collect the name, email address, and message you provide. Submission is voluntary and used only to respond to your inquiry.
pp-collect-analytics-body: We use Vercel Analytics to understand aggregate site usage (pages visited, approximate region, device type). This data is anonymized and is not used to identify individual visitors or for advertising.
pp-use-body: We use the information you provide solely to respond to your inquiries, discuss potential engagements, and improve our website. We do not sell, rent, or trade personal information to third parties.
pp-providers-body: Our website is hosted by Vercel Inc. Contact form submissions are processed and delivered to us by Formspree Inc. These providers process data on our behalf and may store it on servers located outside Canada, including in the United States. By using this website you acknowledge that your information may be subject to the laws of those jurisdictions.
pp-cookies-body: This website does not use advertising or cross-site tracking cookies. A small number of technical mechanisms (such as your language preference) may be stored in your browser to make the site work properly.
pp-retention-body: We keep inquiry correspondence only as long as needed to handle your request or maintain a business relationship, and we apply reasonable technical and organizational safeguards appropriate to the sensitivity of the information.
pp-rights-body1: You may request access to, correction of, or deletion of the personal information we hold about you, or withdraw consent to its use, by contacting us at
pp-rights-body2: You may also direct privacy complaints to the Office of the Privacy Commissioner of Canada.
pp-changes-body: We may update this policy from time to time. The "last updated" date above reflects the most recent revision.
